lastText: Command TerminatedThe Coalition Withdraws ConfidenceMajor DefeatAllied Combined Chiefs, 1940 — 1945End of hostilities: CONFIDENCE WITHDRAWN — filed out of sequence, pages missingImmediate AftermathThis campaign ends here, and not on any battlefield. Coalition Cohesion has run out — not a single ally's objection, but the ███████████ weight of █████ unilateral gambit this command spent it on, past the point the alliance could still function around. Washington and London do not announce a dismissal; supreme command in a coalition war doesn't work by dismissal, it works by a phone call that █████ returning your authority to act. The war continues under whichever compromise the Combined Chiefs can still agree on ███████ you in the room. It was never yours to run alone — █████ choice in this campaign that spent cohesion was, in effect, a bet that it briefly could be. This is what happens when that bet is called too many times.One Year LaterThe war ends under whichever compromise the Combined Chiefs ███████ on without this command in the room. A year on, the history of that final year gets written by whoever was actually present for it — supreme Allied ███████ in a coalition war is, in the end, a chair, and the chair's occupant by V-E Day is not who occupied it when this file was opened.Continental Situation — the Europe this war madeContinental Situation — End of 1945 · Theater Map19391945Theater status board, end of 1945.
